name: Vaigai 07 · Customer account (OTP login, repeat, pause, skip)

parameters.jsCode:
const rnd=String($json.rnd||'');const otp=String(parseInt(rnd.slice(0,8),16)%1000000).padStart(6,'0');const phone=$('Check OTP rate').first().json.phone;
return [{json:{phone,otp,otp_id:'OT'+rnd.slice(8,16),hmac_value:otp+'|'+phone}}];

parameters.content:
CUSTOMER ACCOUNT
Passwordless login: customer enters mobile, gets a 6 digit code on WhatsApp (template login_otp), codes are stored hashed, expire in 5 minutes, max 3 requests per 10 minutes and 5 wrong tries. Session token lasts 30 days. Create tabs OTP and Sessions (see sheets/). Customers can see their last 15 orders, repeat an order, pause, resume, cancel or skip a delivery (cut-off 9 PM the day before). Subscriptions tab needs a phone column that matches the customer's mobile.
Set the values in the Config node (webhook key, Google Sheet ID, WhatsApp and Telegram details). The website sends the same key in the x-vaigai-key header. Credentials: Google Sheets OAuth2, Telegram, OpenAI (assistant only). Nodes marked optional are disabled until you add credentials.
